Repo: seo (Firebase Functions; jest 24 run from repo root: `npx jest --ci <path>`). Slack thread T3 (f2xvjq-10, https://avadaio.slack.com/archives/G01N5G8D562/p1791105893380469): merchant enables Review snippet in Search Appearance, reloads, toggle shows OFF again. Stored data is correct (Firestore + metafield seo.meta2 ratingAndReview.status:true, selected ["ag-product-reviews"]); only the UI status is wrong.

Root cause: packages/functions/src/config/integration/appList.js:28-32 APP_AIR_REVIEW_BLOCKS = ['avada-product-reviews','ag-product-reviews','air-product-reviews']. This shop's Air Reviews app embed in settings_data.json is `shopify://apps/air-reviews-1/blocks/app-embed/c4e1e9ca-4d46-4e76-bc39-7e42417cb327` (Shopify keeps the app handle from install time; same extension uuid as the ag-product-reviews handle). isAppInstalledByBlock (packages/functions/src/services/shopifyGraphQlService.js ~:1921, `block.type.includes(name)`) matches none → installed=[] → getStructuredSetting.js:94-97 forces status=false. gatherShopData.js:82 (GSD autofill) uses the same list.

Fix: add 'air-reviews' to APP_AIR_REVIEW_BLOCKS (matches air-reviews-1 via includes). Before adding, verify it cannot falsely match another app's block type used elsewhere with this list (grep APP_AIR_REVIEW_BLOCKS consumers). Add a one-line why-comment (handle kept from install time, so newer installs carry air-reviews-N). Do not edit shopifyGraphQlService.js, getStructuredSetting.js or gatherShopData.js.

TDD: failing test first: packages/functions/src/config/integration/__tests__/appList.airReviewBlocks.test.js — given block types `shopify://apps/air-reviews-1/blocks/app-embed/c4e1e9ca-4d46-4e76-bc39-7e42417cb327` and the legacy `shopify://apps/ag-product-reviews/blocks/...`, the same predicate isAppInstalledByBlock uses (`APP_AIR_REVIEW_BLOCKS.some(n => type.includes(n))` — check the real implementation and mirror it, or import and call isAppInstalledByBlock with a mocked shopify client if that is cheap) returns true; an unrelated block (e.g. judgeme_core) returns false.

contract.goal: Air Reviews embeds with handle air-reviews-N are detected as installed so the Review snippet toggle keeps its saved state
